name: Can smoke-damaged furniture be fully restored?

mainEntity.name: Can smoke-damaged furniture be fully restored?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restorability of smoke-damaged furniture depends on several factors, including the type of smoke (e.g., wet, dry, protein), the duration of exposure, and the materials of the furniture. Upholstered items can absorb smoke deeply, while solid wood pieces may be easier to clean and deodorize. Professional restoration aims to remove soot, odors, and surface residues, often achieving significant improvement or full restoration. However, severe heat damage or prolonged exposure to corrosive smoke may limit complete restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most smoke-damaged furniture can be significantly restored, but success depends on smoke type, exposure, and furniture materials. Professional cleaning removes soot and odors.
